notes: Own rows S1831/E249 list no pool, pit or grave. Source 2 (Finkelstein 1997 p. 722, Kh. el-Kilya and el-Qasr) names no candidate feature. Source 3: the only SWP entry, Rummun (Mem II p. 292), is the village of Rammun, which source 4 places about 5 km west of the site (square centre 4.2 km); clearly a different place beyond 2 km, so its tank, tomb, cisterns and caves are ignored. Source 4: the court cistern (f19) and crypt (f21-f22) lie in Building I, which the text calls the northern of the two buildings ('Building I is in the north'); their own direction words are relative to the court/building, so relative_to=other. No plan positions: the p. 45 plan has no grid, so the WBADB point cannot be placed on it. Not coded: possible graves under L8 (text says 'perhaps'), a hypothetical 'another cistern outside the building', and the general 'large cisterns' (p. 49). S1894 'pool inside' a dwelling cave coded as pit under the roofed-pool rule. S1838 reservoir is only 'possible'. E248 duplicates S1816 (same site, same cistern); coded for both rows.
